subject: Cleopatra
description: Marble bust of Cleopatra VII of Egypt from ca. 40-30 BC. An ancient Roman bust of Ptolemaic ruler Cleopatra VII of Egypt wearing a royal diadem band over her hair; dated to the mid-1st century BC (i.e. around the time of her visit to Rome), it was discovered in a villa along the Via Appia. It is now located in the Altes Museum, Berlin, in the Antikensammlung Berlin collection. العربية: تمثال لرأس الملكة كليوبترا معروض في متحف ألتيس في برلين Sources: Raia, Ann R.; Sebesta, Judith Lynn.
